title: 13th MEU | Flight Operations Aboard USS Makin Island B-Roll
description: U.S. Marines assigned to Marine Medium Tiltrotor Squadron (VMM) 364 (Reinforced), 13th Marine Expeditionary Unit, and U.S. Navy Sailors assigned to Wasp-class amphibious assault ship USS Makin Island (LHD 8), load ammunition onto a CH-53E Super Stallion, assigned to VMM-364 (Rein.), 13th MEU, during flight operations aboard Makin Island, Oct. 15, 2026. The 13th MEU is currently underway aboard the Makin Island Amphibious Ready Group in the U.S. 3rd Fleet area of operations demonstrating the United States’ long-term commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Sgt. Martha Linares)
